info.name: Pss Engine (Navitaire-style) — Phase 1 + seats
info.description:
Requests for the Pss airline booking engine through the gateway.

1. Import this collection and the 'Pss Local' environment; select the environment.
2. Start the stack (docker compose up --build).
3. Run folder '04 Booking flow' top to bottom (or with the Collection Runner).

Test scripts store token, journeyKey, fareAvailabilityKey, passengerKey, balanceDue, recordLocator, bookingKey in collection variables, so nothing has to be copied by hand. travelDate/returnDate default to today+14/+21.

Full documentation: docs/API_REFERENCE.md

exec: // Default dates: travelDate = today + 14 days, returnDate = today + 21 days (flights are seeded for 30 days).
const addDays = n => new Date(Date.now() + n * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
